texts.li: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about a hard winter long ago, the version with the bear in it.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} what things were like when {A_pronoun} was young, and got a long answer, with names.
{A_nameDef} went through the people of {A_possessive} youth for {B_nameDef}, one by one, and what became of each of them.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: an old hand's correction

texts.li: {A_nameDef} watched {B_nameDef} work for a full minute, then took the tool from {B_possessive} hands and showed {B_objective} a better grip.
"Not like that," {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef}, and showed {B_objective} the way {A_pronoun} was taught forty years ago.
{A_nameDef} passed on to {B_nameDef} a trick of the job that {B_pronoun} had never been told.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: shown the old way of it

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} agreed that everything had been better in their day, including the weather and their knees.
Comparing aches like traders comparing goods, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} gave the prize to {A_nameDef}'s back over {B_nameDef}'s hip.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about people from long ago and laughed at jokes only the two of them still understand.
{A_nameDef} nodded off in the middle of a sentence, and {B_nameDef} put a blanket round {A_possessive} shoulders.
{A_nameDef} dozed off over {A_possessive} work, and {B_nameDef} finished it for {A_objective} without saying so.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: an old game

texts.li: {A_nameDef} taught {B_nameDef} a game {A_pronoun} played as a child, with stones and lines scratched in the dirt.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} how to whistle through {B_possessive} fingers, and {B_nameDef} hasn't stopped since.
{A_nameDef} let {B_nameDef} win an old counting game with pebbles, then stopped letting {B_objective}, and lost anyway.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: an old game in the dirt

texts.li: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef}, at length, everything wrong with young people today, using {B_nameDef} as the example throughout.
{A_nameDef} watched {B_nameDef} work, said, "In my day we did it properly," and didn't explain what properly was.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} a simple question and got a lecture on respect and the state of the colony's boots.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: a saying that helped

texts.li: {B_nameDef} was fretting over a job gone wrong until {A_nameDef} said the best plowman still turns a crooked furrow.
{A_nameDef} answered {B_nameDef}'s long complaint with one old saying, and {B_nameDef} stopped to think about it.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: a saying at the right moment

texts.li: {B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} a straight question, got "patience is a virtue" for an answer, and walked off.
{A_nameDef} said "many hands make light work" while watching {B_nameDef} do all of it.
{B_nameDef} heard the one about the clever fox and the farmer's daughter from {A_nameDef}, and wants it again with the fox winning.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} a story with three dragons in it and no ending yet, and {B_nameDef} keeps asking for one.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: a laugh at the wrong moment

texts.li: {A_nameDef} laughed, the way {A_pronoun} does when things are hard, while {B_nameDef} was talking about the one {B_pronoun} lost.
{A_nameDef} laughed into {A_possessive} sleeve at the mention of the dead, and {B_nameDef} heard it.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: a laugh at a sad time

texts.li: {B_nameDef} swore {B_pronoun} had never promised to help, so {A_nameDef} read {B_objective} the day and the exact words from {A_possessive} notebook.
{A_nameDef} corrected {B_nameDef}'s story from the notebook, page and line, while {B_nameDef} was still telling it.
{B_nameDef} talked {A_nameDef} through why the roof will hold, beam by beam, until {A_nameDef} believed it.
{B_nameDef} counted the stores out loud for {A_nameDef}, sack by sack, to prove there was enough to last.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: volunteered in their place

texts.li: {A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef}'s turn at the filthiest job going before {B_nameDef} had even finished complaining about it.
{A_nameDef} offered to take {B_nameDef}'s night watch, and {B_nameDef} accepted, owing {A_objective} a favor.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: took a turn at the worst job

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: the strays' admirer

texts.li: {A_nameDef} admitted to saving scraps for any stray that comes near, and {B_nameDef} said {B_pronoun} does the same.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} swapped stories of every stray they had ever taken in, bites included.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: a soft spot for strays, shared

texts.li: Last night {B_nameDef} put out {A_nameDef}'s light, {A_nameDef} lit it again, and so it went until someone shouted at them both.
{B_nameDef} complained that {A_nameDef}'s light keeps people awake, and {A_nameDef} said the dark keeps {A_objective} awake.
